sentences.text: Mr. Justice Kanwaljit Singh Ahluwalia Order 21/01/2019
Counsel for the petitioners has contended that sample of turmeric powder was taken from the premises M/

. 
Counsel for the petitioners has contended that petitioners are the partners of a firm and fall in the category of 'Manufacturer'.
Counsel for the petitioners has contended that on 12.08.1998 report of State Public Health Laboratory was received and on basis thereof complaint was filed on 04.04.2001.
Counsel for the petitioners has contended that it was specifically written on the wrapper of the turmeric powder that its expiry date is 01.11.1998.
Petitioners admittedly fall in the category of 'Manufacturers'.
Whether notice was issued to the 'Retailer' under Section 13(2) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and if so, on what date is not discernible from the file of the case.

(2 of 2) [CRLMP-374/2019] Therefore, the present petition is disposed of, with liberty to the petitioners by observing that petitioners if so advised at first instance may file an application for discharge before the trial court enumerating therein all arguments raised in the present petition.

It is further ordered that in case, the said application is filed by the petitioners within two weeks from today, the said application shall be decided by the trial court by passing a detailed speaking order.
Petitioners shall be at liberty to avail remedy of revision.
It is further ordered that till the application of the petitioners for discharge is decided, their personal appearance before the trial court shall remain exempted.
(KANWALJIT SINGH AHLUWALIA),J Heena/106 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
